projects.name: Willow Corporate Website Redesign
projects.cat: Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, JWT, REST APIs, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Postman, Git
projects.status: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Git, Responsive Design, SEO, Performance Optimization
projects.arch:
Existing website codebase review kiya aur redesign project brief/wireframes samjhe.

Semantic HTML5 aur CSS3 se homepage, navbar, hero section, About Us, Services, Portfolio/Projects pages banaye.

Responsive navbar, mobile hamburger menu, image slider/carousel, filterable portfolio grid, smooth-scroll navigation aur scroll animations implement kiye.

Contact form UI with client-side validation banaya.

Bootstrap utility classes use kar ke styling fast ki aur CSS duplication kam ki.

Accessibility improve ki: alt tags, ARIA labels, code review feedback incorporate kiya.

Performance/SEO optimize kiya: image compression, CSS/JS minification, lazy loading, meta tags, Open Graph tags.

Staging server par deploy kiya, cross-browser testing ki, documentation prepare ki.

projects.name: Willow PM
projects.arch:
Project kickoff meeting attend ki, requirements aur feature list discuss ki.

Database schema design, ERD diagram aur tables banaye: users, projects, tasks, comments.

Backend structure Node.js/Express + MySQL mein set up kiya.

REST API endpoints banaye: user registration/login, password hashing, JWT authentication middleware, Projects CRUD, Tasks CRUD.

Frontend dashboard develop kiya: login/signup, sidebar navigation, Projects listing, Task Board with Kanban columns (To Do, In Progress, Done) aur drag-and-drop.

Role-based access control implement kiya: admin vs regular user views.

Filters/search, email/in-app notifications, calendar view, file attachments, activity log/comments add kiye.

Database queries optimize ki: indexes add kiye, redundant queries kam kiye.

Testing ki: unit tests, integration testing, performance testing, regression testing.

Deployment preparation: environment variables, production database settings, technical documentation, user guide, final demo aur handover.

projects.name: Client E-Commerce Platform – QA & Maintenance Support
projects.arch:
Existing e-commerce platform par QA aur maintenance support diya.

Core e-commerce flows test kiye: product browsing, cart, checkout.

Data validation testing ki: required fields, price formats, quantity limits.

Cross-browser testing: Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari.

Responsive/cross-device testing: mobile aur tablet viewports.

Regression testing after bug fixes.

Payment gateway integration flow sandbox/test transactions se test kiya.

Bug tracking system update kiya, retest results aur closed issues maintain kiye.

Frontend bugs fix kiye: CSS layout issues, broken links, JavaScript cart quantity update bug.

Backend minor fix: order-status update logic.

Security checks mein assist kiya: SQL injection aur XSS prevention.

Performance/load testing basics, database maintenance, technical/QA documentation update ki.
